messages:
alex.k: Quick question — need the minimal console role for a telemetry engineer to look at redacted logs in staging for a customer debug. They should only be able to view logs, no edits, and must not see raw PII. What's the least-privilege role?
maria_s: Are they using a human account or a service account?
alex.k: Human (contractor). Short-term access (~48h). Contractor can't use SA creds.
sec_ops: Prefer JIT/ephemeral for contractors. At a minimum roles/logging.viewer at project scope + monitoring viewer usually covers viewing. But logging.viewer still allows reading entries; redaction depends on our pipeline/sinks. Does staging have the redaction step enabled for that log stream?
jaime: Staging does run the redaction pipeline for most telemetry, but a few debug logs are exported raw to a bucket (restricted). If you grant roles/logging.viewer they can read log entries and labels, but not the export bucket unless you also give storage access.
maria_s: If we want extra safety, create a custom role with only: `logging.logEntries.list` and `logging.logEntries.get`. Then bind it to the user at project scope and add a condition limiting to telemetry log names. Example command: ```gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding my-staging --member='user:contractor@example.com' --role='projects/my-staging/roles/telemetryLogRead'```
sec_ops: Good call. Note: if the custom role is org-level we can reuse it across projects, otherwise create per-project. Add an IAM condition such as `resource.name.startsWith("projects/my-staging/logs/telemetry_")` to narrow it. Also set an expiry by scheduling a job to remove the binding after 48h.
audit-bot: Reminder: contractor grants require a ticket in security approvals and a reviewer from sec_ops. Please file SR-7742 (or reference existing SR) before granting.
jaime: Will create the custom role + SR. Plan: custom role with only `logging.logEntries.list` and `logging.logEntries.get`, IAM condition on logName, grant for 48h, and confirm no storage roles are given. I'll post the binding here when done. :thumbsup:
alex.k: Thanks — please confirm explicitly that they will NOT get access to the raw export bucket. I'll only proceed once SR is filed and role exists.
sec_ops: We'll add an IAM deny policy on the export buckets for any member in the contractor group as extra protection. CC'ing infra in the SR for enforcement.
maria_s: Marking this thread resolved for now — ping if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
